subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should every standalone MCP adapter expose one standardized startup-error envelope, or should each entrypoint retain an adapter-specific diagnostic prefix?
rationale: Current main already shares the operational pipeline, while the remaining text encodes adapter identity; source inspection alone cannot determine whether identical diagnostics are a supported cross-adapter contract.

options.title: Keep adapter-owned prefixes
options.body: Retain the small local prefixes because they preserve attribution and avoid an abstraction without shared behavior.

options.title: Define one diagnostics contract
options.body: Introduce an adapter-aware helper covering OpenClaw tools, Codex supervision, plugin tools, and future standalone MCP entrypoints with focused tests.

recommendation.title: Keep adapter-owned prefixes
recommendation.body: Retain the small local prefixes because they preserve attribution and avoid an abstraction without shared behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-based owner for the Codex supervision side of the proposed cross-adapter contract.
